groups.name: Prettier configuration for review artifacts
groups.rationale: Adds the `.lavish/` directory to prettier ignore rules so that recorded review artifacts are not reformatted as source code.
groups.watch: The comment must accurately describe what `.lavish/` contains and why it should never be formatted by prettier; if the directory purpose changes, this exclusion could become incorrect.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
